mapper.select: SELECT id, template_id, section_id, field_id, canonical, label, data_type, field_type, dict_key, role, required, sort_order FROM cage_form_field WHERE template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, template_id, section_id, field_id, canonical, label, data_type, field_type, dict_key, role, required, sort_order FROM cage_form_field WHERE field_id = #{fieldId} ORDER BY template_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_form_field (template_id, section_id, field_id, canonical, label, data_type, field_type, dict_key, role, required, sort_order) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{sectionId}, #{fieldId}, #{canonical}, #{label}, #{dataType}, #{fieldType}, #{dictKey}, #{role}, #{required}, #{sortOrder})
